title: Cart
description: Full-viewport cart screen composing the shopping-cart block: the lines a shopper picked — image, linked name, options, price, a quantity box and Remove — and the order summary with the subtotal, a note and Checkout, with the block's loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container): the masthead lines up at @sm and the footer at @md; inside, the block stacks the summary under the lines on narrow containers and sets it beside them from its own @lg.
